entries.title: II Corinthians 12:1
segments: Indeed, it is not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of [the] Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:2
segments: I know a man in Christ fourteen years before (whether in [the] body, I do not know; or outside of [the] body, I do not know; God knows) such a one [was] caught up to [the] third Heaven.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:3
segments: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I do not know; God knows),

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:4
segments: that he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not allowed for a man to utter.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:5
segments: I will glory of such a one, yet I will not boast on my behalf, except in my weaknesses.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:6
segments: For if I desire to boast, I shall not be foolish. For I will speak the truth. But I spare, lest anyone should think of me as [being] beyond what he sees me, or hears of me;

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:7
segments: and by the surpassing revelations, lest I not be made haughty, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I be made haughty.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:8
segments: For this thing I besought the Lord three times, that it might depart from me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:9
segments: And He said to me, My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may overshadow me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:10
segments: Therefore I am pleased in weaknesses, in insults, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake; for when I am weak, then I am powerful.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:11
segments: I have become foolish boasting. You compelled me. For I ought to be commended by you. For I lacked nothing of the highest apostles, though I am nothing.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:12
segments: Truly the signs of the apostles were worked out among you in all patience, in miracles and in wonders, and by works of power.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:13
segments: For what is it in which you were inferior to the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:14
segments: Behold, a third [time] I am ready to come to you. And I will not burden you, for I do not seek your things, but you. For the children ought not to lay up treasure for the parents, but the parents for the children.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:15
segments: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for your souls, even if loving you more and more, I am loved [the] less.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:16
segments: But let it be so, I did not burden you. But being crafty, I caught you with bait.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:17
segments: By any whom I have sent to you, did I overreach you by him?

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:18
segments: I begged Titus and sent with [him] the brother. Did Titus overreach you? Did we not walk in the same spirit? Did we not walk in the same steps?

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:19
segments: Again, do you think we are defending to you? We speak before God in Christ, but [we do] all things, dearly beloved, for your building up.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:20
segments: For I fear, lest somehow coming I might not find you as I wish, and [that] I shall be found by you such as you might not wish; lest somehow [there be] strifes, envyings, angers, contentions, backbitings, whisperings, proud thoughts, tumults;

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:21
segments: lest in my coming again my God will humble me with you; and I shall mourn many who have already sinned, and not repenting over the uncleanness, and fornication, and lustfulness which they have practiced.
